declaration.goal: Move ahead by about 0.45 m and stop there, keeping the heading within 12 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN channel c0 is held at 0.5 for the whole trial and c1 to c4 are 0, THE system SHALL end with x between 0.3 and 2.0 m.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c0=0.5 alone gave x=0.00005 m, so P1 (x in 0.3 to 2.0) is wrong. c1=0.5 alone moved the body backward at about 0.024 m/s steady (x=-0.119 m) while turning CCW at about 4.4 deg/s (heading 21.8 deg). c2=0.5 alone gave only a small early twitch (x=-0.017 m, heading 0.09 deg), then nothing. c3 and c4 untested.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c3 is held at 0.5 for the whole trial and the other channels are 0, THE system SHALL end with x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c3 or c4 alone drives forward motion

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c3 or c4 alone drives forward motion

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c3=0.5 alone gave x=-0.003 m, c4=0.5 alone x=-0.005 m, and c0=c2=0.5 together x=-0.017 m. None moved forward. Each shows only a small settling twitch in the first 0.1 s, then stays still. Only c1 has produced steady motion so far (backward plus CCW turn).

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at 0.5 and c0, c2, c3 and c4 are all held at 0.5, THE system SHALL end with heading within 10 degrees of 21.8 deg less than the c1-alone result or x above -0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Another channel balances the c1 turn and changes the drive

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Another channel balances the c1 turn and changes the drive

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Adding other channels to c1=0.5 never gave forward motion: all five at 0.5 gave x=-0.137 m, heading 53.7 deg; c0+c1+c2 gave x=-0.161 m, heading 29.0 deg; c1+c3+c4 gave x=-0.129 m, heading 42.1 deg. Heading rate looks additive: c1 alone 4.4 deg/s, c0+c2 add about 1.4 deg/s, c3+c4 add about 4 deg/s. So c3 and c4 are positive turn contributors only when c1 is on, and backward drift stays near 0.024 m/s. Turning the whole trace looks like linear mixing, which suggests c1 negative drives forward with a clockwise turn that c3 and c4 positive could cancel.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at -1 and c3 and c4 are held at 1 for the whole trial with c0 and c2 at 0, THE system SHALL end with x above 0.15 m and heading within 12 degrees of 0.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Negative c1 drives forward and c3, c4 positive cancel the turn

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Negative c1 drives forward and c3, c4 positive cancel the turn

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: With c1=-1, c3=c4=1 the body moved forward (x=0.095 m, so the sign flip works) but turned CW to heading -54.8 deg (about -11 deg/s), so P2 (heading within 12 deg) is rejected. P1 (x above 0.15 m) is rejected too: forward speed was only about 0.02 m/s. c3 and c4 at +1 did not cancel the turn at c1=-1, so the c1 turn grows faster than linearly with |c1|, or c3 and c4 saturate.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at -0.7 and c0, c2, c3 and c4 are held at 1 for the whole trial, THE system SHALL end with heading within 15 degrees of 0 and x above 0.05 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Smaller negative c1 with c0, c2, c3, c4 at 1 keeps heading small

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Smaller negative c1 with c0, c2, c3, c4 at 1 keeps heading small

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c1=-0.7 with c0,c2,c3,c4 at 1 gave x=0.080 m and heading -88.6 deg, far outside the predicted -30 to 15 deg. P1 rejected, P2 (x 0.05 to 0.3) held. Compared with E4, adding c0 and c2 at +1 made the CW turn much worse (about -17.7 deg/s), so with c1 negative their effect has the opposite sign to the one seen at c1=+0.5. Negative c0 and c2 should then give CCW turn that cancels the c1 turn.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at -0.8, c0 and c2 are held at -0.7, and c3 and c4 are 0 for the whole trial, THE system SHALL end with heading within 12 degrees of 0 and x above 0.1 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Negative c0 and c2 cancel the c1 turn

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Negative c0 and c2 cancel the c1 turn

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c1=-0.8, c0=c2=-0.7 gave x=0.087 m and heading -24.4 deg. P1 (heading within 12 deg) failed and P2 (x 0.1 to 0.3) failed by 0.013 m. Negative c0 and c2 reduced the CW turn (about -4.9 deg/s versus about -11 deg/s with c0,c2 at +1) but did not cancel it, and forward speed stayed near 0.02 m/s, so 0.45 m was not reached. The budget is used up. The final trial is forward 0.087 m with heading -24 deg, which does not meet the goal.
